    // A sixty-hertz fixed step with the iteration counts a real-time simulation
    // usually settles on: velocity iterations dominate contact stiffness and
    // position iterations only remove leftover overlap, so the first number is the
    // larger. MaxStepsPerFrame bounds catch-up after a long frame, which is what
    // stops a stalled tab from simulating a minute of physics on resume.
    SixtyHertz(_: TimeStepSettings): TimeStepSettings
        => TimeStepSettings(Duration(1.0 / 60.0), 1, 8, 3, 4);
